compiled_state.title: Add OPENAI_API_KEY to ci.yml llm-review env block
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: .github/workflows/ci.yml passes OPENAI_API_KEY from secrets to the llm-review job env block alongside ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
- DD6: OPENAI_API_KEY presence in GitHub Actions secrets has been confirmed via gh secret list at the relevant repo (or org) scope before merge; if missing, the story cannot close and a parent action item is opened to provision it

## Implementation Notes

File to edit: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

At line 169 (the `env:` block of the `Run LLM review` step in the `llm-review` job), add:
```yaml
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
```
immediately after the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}` line.

Result should be:
```yaml
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```

Then verify OPENAI_API_KEY is configured in GitHub Actions secrets:
```bash
gh secret list 2>/dev/null | grep -i OPENAI_API_KEY
```
If not present: create a bug/action-item ticket: `.claude/scripts/dso ticket create task "Provision OPENAI_API_KEY in GitHub Actions secrets" --parent=8b07-69d1 --priority=1 -d "OPENAI_API_KEY must be added to repo/org secrets before OpenAI-path CI review can run. See story 8b07-69d1 DD6."`

## TDD Requirement

testing_mode: GREEN — unit exemption criteria 1, 2, and 3 all apply:
1. No conditional logic: YAML env block is purely structural wiring
2. Any test would be a change-detector (checking the YAML key exists)
3. Infrastructure boundary only: CI workflow, not application code

No RED test task required. Exemption documented per TDD criteria.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "FAILED: 0"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true
- [ ] OPENAI_API_KEY present in ci.yml llm-review env block
  Verify: grep -q "OPENAI_API_KEY.*secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY" .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] ANTHROPIC_API_KEY still present (no regression)
  Verify: grep -q "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.*secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" .github/workflows/ci.yml
- [ ] OPENAI_API_KEY secrets presence confirmed (or action item opened if missing)
  Verify: gh secret list 2>/dev/null | grep -i OPENAI_API_KEY || echo "ACTION REQUIRED: provision OPENAI_API_KEY secret before merging"
